rules.headings: Uppercase, tight tracking (tracking-tighter), thick weights (font-black or font-extrabold).
rules.body: Regular to medium weights, leading-relaxed for descriptions, tracking-wide for uppercase subheadings.
rules.badges: Tiny (text-[10px] to text-xs), uppercase, font-bold, tracking-[0.2em].

spacing_and_layout.grid_product: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6 lg:gap-8
spacing_and_layout.hero: h-[100svh] min-h-[600px] flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden

product_card.style: Dark luxury styling. No harsh white borders. Use subtle border-white/5. Background is surface (#171513).
product_card.interaction: 3D tilt on hover (using framer-motion useSpring/useMotionValue), image scales up slightly (scale-105).
product_card.badges: Absolute positioned over the image. Example: bg-brand-accent text-white px-2 py-1 uppercase text-[10px] tracking-widest.

hero.style: Cinematic. Video background (travis.mp4) covering 100% w/h. Overlay bg-black/60 to bg-black/80 gradient.
hero.content: Massive headline in Cabinet Grotesk, centered or bottom-left aligned. CTA button uses brand-sand background with black text.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D2C4A7] text-[#0C0A09] hover:bg-white transition-colors duration-300 font-bold tracking-wide uppercase px-8 py-4 rounded-none
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#7A7365] text-[#F5F5F0] hover:border-[#D2C4A7] hover:text-[#D2C4A7] transition-all px-8 py-4 rounded-none uppercase font-bold tracking-wide
buttons.accent: bg-[#8C2222] text-white hover:bg-red-800 transition-colors uppercase font-bold px-8 py-4 rounded-none

header.style: Fixed, top-0, w-full, z-50. Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0C0A09]/70 border-b border-white/5. Minimalist layout.
header.links: Hover state: text-[#D2C4A7] transition-colors. Desktop visible.

cart_drawer.style: Slide-in from right. bg-[#171513] border-l border-white/5. Contains order summary, items list with quantity edit, fake shipping calc.

motion.page_load: Fade in, slide up staggered (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> 1, duration: 0.8s, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]).
motion.scroll: Parallax on large images and backgrounds.
motion.hover: High-end 3D tilt on cards. Micro-interactions on buttons (scale down slightly on tap: scale-95).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure off-white text (#F5F5F0) against dark backgrounds (#0C0A09, #171513) meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.testing_attributes: Add data-testid='...' to all buttons, links, inputs, and interactive cards.
accessibility.focus: Use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D2C4A7] focus:outline-none for keyboard navigation.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, lucide-react (or @phosphor-icons/react), tailwind-merge, clsx.
Implement a custom 3D Tilt Card component using framer-motion for the sneaker products.
Build a cinematic hero section using the provided travis.mp4 as background with a dark overlay.
The e-commerce must simulate a cart using LocalStorage or React Context.
Include a 'Checkout Demo' flow with forms for personal data, address, and payment, ending in a success page.
Do NOT use standard rounded corners. Use rounded-none or very small rounded-sm to keep the brutalist/luxury aesthetic.
Add decorative sections using the provided fachada.png for the physical store and floating travis icon PNGs.
Create a Sorteio/Giveaway section for purchases above R$ 50.000.
Footer must contain 'Developed by José Ferreira / Sick Code' linking to sickcode.com.br.
